selection: Declared diagnostic frame from the prior receipt, not a physical preference or isotope selection.
interpretation: Relative geometric/native attachment: occupied bodies belong to esd7, reference context may be external and must be recorded separately. No new occupied body is admitted by reference completion.
procedure: Generate target primitives and their native lattice owners independently.
Map every occupied cell and alias; retain all packet IDs, origins, permutations and construction histories.
Use existing native chart/reference completion and transfer validation, including actual lattice neighbors. Record any failed completion or transfer without changing its rules.
Invert every coordinate binding and check exact source recovery; ledger every external reference and every newly generated reference-only cell separately from occupancy.
Reject controls deleting or clipping external C0 and changing coefficient permutations.
State the remaining analytical-domain obligation explicitly; geometric reference completion is not an analytical extension operator.
successCriterion: All occupied cells bind to actual target primitives, native references and all transfers validate, and all coordinates/histories recover without lost external context.
failureCriterion: An exact native completion, transfer or recovery equation fails for the registered frame.
